# TeleportPointEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Movement/TeleportPointEditor.cs#L11)

Editor for the TeleportPoint script. The inspector is the framework's default one, since a
point has nothing unusual to lay out; this exists so the object gets the recenter's
hierarchy icon, which a plain registry entry in VRFDefaultEditors.cs could not give it.

```csharp
[CustomEditor(typeof(TeleportPoint))]
[CanEditMultipleObjects]
public class TeleportPointEditor : VRFDefaultEditor
```
